dedupe_keys.name: sociedade ponto verde statistics packaging waste taken back from separate collection in portugal by material 2001 to 2025

description: These statistics trace how much packaging waste put in recycling bins in Portugal has been taken back for recycling each year, by material. They are published by Sociedade Ponto Verde, which has worked since 1996 within the integrated packaging waste management system (SIGRE) in Portugal. The main table gives, for each year, the tonnes taken back from the separate collection of the municipal waste management systems, in total and split into glass, plastic, paper and cardboard, metal and wood, with steel and aluminium shown separately from 2025. In 2025 the total was about 487,000 tonnes, against about 97,000 tonnes in 2001. The table is free and available on the web page; no download file was found, so values must be read from the page. Caveats: the figures cover only packaging handled by this one compliance scheme, not all packaging or municipal waste, and they are national totals without municipal detail. Simulation uses: setting material flows from separate collection into sorting and recycling in waste system models, and testing growth in recycling capacity. Related records: the Italian ISPRA municipal waste data (data-ispra-catasto-rifiuti-municipal-waste) and the Finnish packaging volumes (data-finland-packaging-volumes-epr) are comparable sources.
